_readme: Copy to identity.json (gitignored) and fill in. Only add a field if you want the agent hunting for it -- every value here is a search term, so listing your full address means that address gets typed into a search engine. Start with name/city/email/handles; add phone and address once the matching looks right to you.

consent.note: This identity is my own. I am scanning for my own exposure in order to get it removed.

contact.note: Reply address used in drafted removal requests. Consider a dedicated alias.
